newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Oman Development Bank signs $45 mln loan facility.
newsitem.headline: Oman Development Bank signs $45 mln loan facility.

text.p: The Arab Investment Company (TAIC) said on Monday it had arranged a $45 million syndicated term loan facility for state-owned Oman Development Bank.
A TAIC statement said the five-year facility, signed in Bahrain, had an annual margin of 0.45 percent over London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR).
Bahrain-based Arab Banking Corporation and Gulf International Bank, Saudi Arabia's National Commercial Bank and Japan's Fuji Bank Limited took part in the financing.

"The bank (Oman Development Bank) has a mandate to provide loans, with subsidised rates and soft loans on behalf of the Ministry of Finance to Omani companies for the purpose of financing projects," the TAIC statement said.
TAIC was established in 1974 by 15 Arab states to invest money in Arab projects. It has an offshore banking unit with the same name in Bahrain.
